findings.summary: Runtime interventions such as RescaleCFG and MaHiRo must remain separate from base-model capability evidence.
Recommended runtime profile remains model/version-scoped; do not flatten into generic Illustrious defaults.
Author-recommended Euler a / CFG 5-6 / 25-30 step profile remains current.
v1.0, v1.1, and v2.0-STABLE are distinct model identities with materially different positioning; store as separate profiles.

tool_impact: Keep runtime intervention metadata separate from model capability.
Require explicit model/version identity in guidance and examples.
Do not inherit settings across Illustrious-family releases without evidence.
